notes: Phones behave like phones. Batteries drain (faster for people glued to their screens) and charge at home or overnight; a power bank gives you +50%. A dead phone can't text or call, and a character's dead phone means your texts wait until they charge it.
No signal inside Hollows, tunnels, basements and the like: your texts queue and go out when you're back in range, and calls won't connect.
Read receipts: Sent, Delivered, Read 14:02. Characters can leave you on read, and they remember doing it.
Missed calls offer to leave a voicemail, and the character reacts to it when they get to it (call back, text back, or not). Calls to a dead or out-of-range phone go straight to voicemail.
